Information regarding message
1. Information regarding message received from the National Assembly
Secretary of the House of Representatives, Prakash Adhikari, will provide information regarding the "Bill to Amend the Election of Members of the House of Representatives (First Amendment), 2083".

2. Secretary of the House of Representatives, Prakash Adhikari, will table the "Voter List (First Amendment) Bill, 2083" along with the message received from the National Assembly.
